papers.title: Tribology of selective laser melting processed parts: Stainless steel 316 L under lubricated conditions
papers.first_author_affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Fluid Power Transmission and Control, Zhejiang University, Zheda Road 38, 310027 Hangzhou, China

corresponding_authors.name: Jun Zou
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Fluid Power Transmission and Control, Zhejiang University, Zheda Road 38, 310027 Hangzhou, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM制造316L不锈钢的摩擦学性能，未涉及骨植入物的应力遮挡、疲劳或多孔结构，与生物医学应用方向关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration, and the lubricated tribology context is not directly applicable to biomedical implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究SLM工艺对316L不锈钢润滑条件下摩擦学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备316L试样并进行销盘摩擦磨损试验
summary_zh.result: SLM试样耐磨性优于锻造试样，磨损机理主要为磨粒磨损
summary_zh.validation: 通过销盘摩擦磨损实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the tribological performance of selective laser melted 316L stainless steel under lubricated conditions.
summary_en.method: SLM-fabricated 316L specimens were tested using pin-on-disc tribometry under lubricated conditions.
summary_en.result: SLM parts exhibited superior wear resistance compared to wrought counterparts, with abrasive wear as the dominant mechanism.
